title: U.S. House · California's 51st District
area: Central San Diego, including much of the City of San Diego.

context.text: The district's boundaries changed as a result of California Proposition 50, a mid-decade congressional redistricting measure voters approved on November 5, 2025.

Incumbent Sara Jacobs and Ricardo Cabrera advanced from the June 2, 2026 top-two primary, defeating David Engel and Stan Caplan. Jacobs won 57.7% of the primary vote (111,765 votes) and Cabrera won 37.0% (71,692 votes).

candidates.name: Sara Jacobs
candidates.ballotNote: Won the June 2, 2026 top-two primary with 57.7% of the vote.

summary.text: Sara Jacobs is the incumbent Democratic U.S. Representative, first elected in 2022. Before Congress she worked as a policy advisor on Hillary Clinton's 2016 presidential campaign, held policy positions at the U.S. State Department, UNICEF and the United Nations, and founded San Diego for Every Child: The Coalition to End Child Poverty.

background.text: Born in San Diego, California, in 1989.
Earned a bachelor's degree in political science and a master's degree in international affairs from Columbia University in 2011 and 2012.
Worked as a policy advisor on Hillary Clinton's 2016 presidential campaign and held policy positions with the U.S. State Department, UNICEF and the United Nations.
Founded San Diego for Every Child: The Coalition to End Child Poverty and served as CEO of Project Connect.

record.text: Serves on the House Committee on Armed Services (Intelligence and Special Operations and Military Personnel subcommittees) and the House Committee on Foreign Affairs for the 119th Congress (2025-2026).
Served as ranking member of the Foreign Affairs Subcommittee on Africa during the 118th Congress (2023-2024).

candidates.researchNotes: Jacobs has not completed Ballotpedia's 2026 Candidate Connection survey, and no campaign-website issue statements could be retrieved in this environment, so no sourced issue positions are included.

candidates.name: Ricardo Cabrera
candidates.ballotNote: Advanced from the June 2, 2026 top-two primary with 37.0% of the vote.

summary.text: Ricardo Cabrera is a San Diego small business owner and cybersecurity professional running as the Republican candidate for CA-51. He has not previously held elected office.

background.text: Describes himself as a San Diegan, small business owner and cybersecurity professional.

priorities.text: Supporting congressional term limits, saying Washington needs "citizen legislators, not career politicians."
Addressing affordability, saying families are being "priced out, taxed out, and pushed out of California."
Fiscal responsibility and public safety, describing government that "focuses on results instead of bureaucracy."
